release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.23 - iOS FCM Notifications Fix:
- Fixed iOS FCM token retrieval with retry logic for APNs token registration
- Improved iOS FCM service initialization with platform-specific retry mechanism
- Enhanced AppDelegate error handling and logging for APNs token registration
- Fixed Info.plist configuration (removed duplicate keys, cleaned deprecated entries)
- Improved server APNs payload structure with proper headers
- Better diagnostic logging for iOS FCM token registration
- iOS notifications now properly handle APNs token timing issues
- All iOS FCM configurations reviewed and optimized
